method: Static inspection of official Darwin arm64 and Linux x64 package/claude files. Hashes match dist-inventory.json. No downloaded executable was run.
safe_mode_option_description_parts: Start with all customizations (CLAUDE.md, skills, installed plugins, hooks, MCP servers, custom commands and agents, output styles, workflows, custom themes, keybindings, and more) disabled
\u2014 useful for troubleshooting a broken configuration.
Admin-managed (policy) settings still apply. Auth, model selection, built-in tools and plugins, and permissions work normally. Sets CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1.
safe_mode_option_description_byte_identi: The frozen claude-code-2.1.316 fixture proves 2.1.312..=2.1.316 byte identity; this run reproduces that 2.1.316 text exactly and the 2.1.317 description text is byte-identical to it again.
cc_plugin_ids_note: 2.1.317 adds cc-plugin-privacy to the unconditional builtin initializer; the other thirteen ids are unchanged. Per-version rows carry their own id list.

privacy_plugin.registration_site: unconditional builtin initializer, registered next to cc-plugin-sec-default, cc-plugin-agents-md, and cc-plugin-telemetry before the CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT gate
privacy_plugin.description: Privacy: asks before a shell or web tool runs with the signed-in account's email address in a call that may leave the machine
privacy_plugin.hook_surface: tool.check over WebBrowser, WebFetch, WebSearch, Bash, Monitor, PowerShell, and Tmux; decision ask when the call input carries the account email
privacy_plugin.reason: Headless selects Read,Glob,Grep and response-only runs with empty tools, so no web or shell tool call can occur on either route. The plugin contributes no MCP server. Hook events reach the stream only through --include-hook-events, which neither route passes.
